status: Tested candidate applied to the working tree, uncommitted. No CI query or trigger, push or dependency change.
scope: Current tracked source based on 8c7a290 plus inherited worker cleanup; excludes unrelated untracked src/shared-context.ts. Comparisons are not against 0.9.1 and do not retroactively validate earlier changes.

changes: Reuse the split path array while escaping segments, removing filter/map intermediate arrays.
Skip resetting unchanged style contents, with a second read to preserve the original behavior when hooks mutate the element.

decisions.pathFilterOnly: Not selected alone: small/inconsistent allocation changes. Superseded by in-place segment transformation.
decisions.styleGuard: Retained. Skipping solely because the returned string equals the original would mishandle hook mutations; the second content check is required.
decisions.pathInplace: Retained with unchanged dot-segment sanitization and escaping. No URIjs replacement.
decisions.cssScanner: Previous decision unchanged: current regex retained; no full CSS parser.

environment.host: Continued on the shared host without waiting for idle. Workload probes and identical-code controls determine timing classification.
environment.dependencies: Same physical existing packages for all variants, with frozen existing MDN lifecycle dependencies.

allocation.protocol: Three rotated baseline/candidate/identical-candidate triplets per normal/pressure mode; inspector 4096-byte sampling includes objects collected by major/minor GC. Sum profile tree selfSize. Four documents/batches for focused cases; three HTML documents plus one stylesheet per MDN crawl.
allocation.pressure: Real JavaScript arrays retained up to 2 MiB, released before post-GC checks; identical harness churn included in totals.
allocation.limits: Sampled cumulative allocation, not exact allocation, RSS, retained heap or peak memory; descriptive paired medians without formal confidence bounds.

focusedScopes.pipeline: Style guard plus filter-only path experiment.
focusedScopes.inplace: Selected in-place path transformation alone; HTML/SVG fixtures contain image links and no style blocks.

timing.protocol: Separate unprofiled timings; two observations per variant. Three discarded calibration triplets. Whole-case triplet excluded if any CPU/IO probe exceeds 1.5x median calibration group maximum. 10000 deterministic bootstrap draws, seed 123456789. Control interval must include zero and lie within +/-5%; both candidate effects must agree for faster/slower.
timing.mdn: 12 measured rounds, minimum 8; balanced rotation/reversal, same warmed process. Fixed threshold formula; numeric thresholds computed from calibration after collection without adapting to candidate outcomes.
timing.focused: 18 interleaved rounds, minimum 12; thresholds frozen after calibration.
timing.conclusion: MDN faster in both modes; normal link-chain faster. Other normal focused cases unresolved except duplicate CSS control failure; all pressure-focused controls fail. No universal speedup or strict non-regression guarantee.

protocol.noise: Whole triplet exclusion on any CPU/IO probe above 1.5x median of three calibration group maxima.
protocol.control: 95% paired control interval contains zero and fits within +/-5%. Both candidate effects must agree.

mdn-local.description: Saved MDN document replay with real MDN lifecycle, plus CSS extracted from its 16 inline style blocks; local acquisition, real output writes and disposal.

protocol.unit: Two-observation per-variant median, paired by interleaved round; all variants in one warmed process
protocol.noise: 1.5 times median of three calibration group maxima, fixed before measurement; entire case triplet excluded on any CPU/IO exceedance

protocol.control: 95% interval includes zero and lies within +/-5%
protocol.unit: Two-observation per-variant median, paired by interleaved round; all variants in one warmed process

retention.protocol: Ten complete MDN crawls after warmup in separate baseline/final/identical-final processes per mode, GC before/after samples.
retention.conclusion: Final post-GC heaps are near 21 MiB for all variants. Late upward drift is similar in baseline and candidate; no additional retained-heap growth relative to baseline was observed in this short check. RSS differences vary by mode; no general RSS reduction claim.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
source /mnt/e/tmp/wse-markup-path-20261004/env.sh
export WSE_FOCUSED_CASES=css-unique,html-links,svg-links,link-chain
for pressure in 0 1; do
 export WSE_HEAP_PRESSURE=$pressure
 for round in 0 1 2; do
  for k in 0 1 2; do
   variant=$(( (k + round) % 3 ));name=inplace
   if [ "$variant" = 0 ]; then name=baseline; fi
   node --expose-gc --max-old-space-size=128 --max-semi-space-size=4 /mnt/e/tmp/wse-markup-path-20261004/harness/pipeline.mjs "/mnt/e/tmp/wse-markup-path-20261004/variants/$name/lib/index.js" profile "/mnt/e/tmp/wse-markup-path-20261004/profiles/inplace-p$pressure-r$round-v$variant" > "/mnt/e/tmp/wse-markup-path-20261004/logs/inplace-p$pressure-r$round-v$variant.json"
  done
 done
done
